svg.title: A nurse is teaching a client who has a right leg injury how to use crutches on stairs. Which of the following instructions should the nurse include?
svg.desc: The rule is UP WITH THE GOOD LEG, DOWN WITH THE BAD. The unaffected left leg steps up first, and going down the affected right leg moves with the crutches. Leading up with the injured leg forces the weak limb to bear full body weight against gravity and greatly increases the risk of a fall.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Assistive Devices
Read the situation
A nurse is teaching a client who has a
right leg injury how to use crutches on
stairs. Which of the following
instructions should the nurse include?
What fits here
'Lead with your left leg going up the
stairs and with your right leg going
down.'
Why it fits
The rule is UP WITH THE GOOD LEG, DOWN
WITH THE BAD. The unaffected left leg
steps up first, and going down the
affected right leg moves with the
crutches. Leading up with the injured leg
forces the weak limb to bear full body
weight against gravity and greatly
increases the risk of a fall.
